about_blocks.text: Michael and his team help empower individuals and families across Canada and throughout the world to overcome substance use, addiction, and mental health challenges. Our compassionate, expert-led services provide personalized support for lasting recovery, delivered through secure tele-therapy, online video and some in-person options.

about_blocks.text: Our Addiction and Mental Health Services

items.text: Sober Coaching: One-on-one guidance and accountability for those in early recovery or post-rehab, helping you stay on track and working toward your goals for change and growth.
items.html: Sober Coaching: One-on-one guidance and accountability for those in early recovery or post-rehab, helping you stay on track and working toward your goals for change and growth.

items.text: Addiction Recovery Coaching: Tailored approach for those who are sober curious wanting to reduce intake or take a break from consuming alcohol.
items.html: Addiction Recovery Coaching: Tailored approach for those who are sober curious wanting to reduce intake or take a break from consuming alcohol.

items.text: Intervention Services: Support for families to lovingly guide a loved one toward treatment with empathy and clarity.
items.html: Intervention Services: Support for families to lovingly guide a loved one toward treatment with empathy and clarity.

items.text: Family Support: Resources and counselling using the CRAFT Model of Addiction to help families navigate addiction’s impact together.
items.html: Family Support: Resources and counselling using the CRAFT Model of Addiction to help families navigate addiction’s impact together.

items.text: Assessments: Comprehensive psychological, substance use, and mental health evaluations to inform your recovery plan.
items.html: Assessments: Comprehensive psychological, substance use, and mental health evaluations to inform your recovery plan.

items.text: Online Addiction Treatment: Do rehab online at home with Home Based Recovery providing psycho-educational and skills-building content while matched up with a recovery coach or therapist for 20-hours of support in our 30-day program.

sponsor.text: Are you or a loved one struggling with alcohol or drug addiction? Finding the right addiction treatment centre can make all the difference in achieving long-term recovery. That's why we've done the research for you and compiled a list of the best alcohol and drug addiction centres in Canada. Our list includes top-rated addiction treatment centres that provide evidence-based therapies, personalized treatment plans, and aftercare support services to help clients overcome addiction and maintain a healthy, fulfilling life in recovery. Whether you're looking for residential or outpatient treatment, we've got you covered. For immediate treatment help call: 1-855-885-4747
